newsitem.title: USA: WMS Industries wins approval for new games.
newsitem.headline: WMS Industries wins approval for new games.

text.p: WMS Industries Inc said Monday the Nevada Gaming Commission approved its plans to distribute a line of casino games in that state.

The company said its Williams Quantum XL video machine offers 11 popular casino video games, while a casino slot machine version has a slant-top design that offers players a higher lavel of comfort. Both machines feature high-resolution 19-inch video screens, WMS Industries said.
WMS Industries designs and makes coin-operated and home video games, pinball and video lottery terminals.
Its shares were trading up 1/8 Monday at 23-7/8.
